title: How to organise the books and quiet play zone | Nursery
description:
A short, calm set of things your baby can reach and choose without you handing anything over.

This is the Books and Quiet Play Zone in the Nursery. About 15-30 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Twelve board books standing cover out on a low ledge, one basket of soft toys filled level with the rim and no higher, the rest boxed in the closet as rotation stock, and a clear stretch of floor big enough for an adult to lie down on.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Sit on the floor at your baby's eye level and pick up every book and toy in reach.
Straighten: Covers face out along the ledge, because a pre-reader chooses by picture and cannot read a spine.
Shine: Wipe the board book covers and the ledge, since chewed corners and drool are essentially the whole cleaning jo
Safety: Bolt the shelf or ledge to the wall, because the day your baby pulls to standing it becomes the nearest handho
Standardize: Twelve covers on the ledge, one basket level with its rim.
Sustain: When you switch the lamp off after the bedtime story, stand the books back cover out and swap two off the ledg

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Twelve covers facing out and one basket at the rim; everything else waits in the rotation box.

Full written steps for this zone, free:
https://6s-success.com/zones/nursery-the-books-and-quiet-play-zone.html

6S Success turns Lean's six-S method into something you can actually do in a house: Sort, Straighten, Shine, Safety, Standardize, Sustain. One small zone at a time, finished in one session, and it stays finished.
